<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>روابط وملفات PDF - كوميكس أوفرلاي</title>
<style>
:root{
  --primary:#D90429;
  --primary-dark:#8D0801;
  --accent:#FFB703;
  --highlight:#FB8500;
  --control:#2B2D42;
  --bg:#F2F3F7;
  --surface:#FFFFFF;
  --ink:#141622;
  --muted:#5C6078;
  --border:#E0E3EB;
  --success:#1B9AAA;
}
*{
  box-sizing:border-box;
  margin:0;
  padding:0;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
html,body{
  width:100%;
  min-height:100%;
  background-color:var(--bg);
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:'Segoe UI',Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;
  line-height:1.45;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
body{
  background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(43,45,66,0.06) 1.2px, transparent 1.2px);
  background-size:14px 14px;
  padding-top:calc(62px + env(safe-area-inset-top));
  padding-bottom:calc(78px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}
a{
  text-decoration:none;
  color:inherit;
}
button,input,select{
  font-family:inherit;
}
.rt-selectable{
  -webkit-user-select:text !important;
  user-select:text !important;
}

/* App Bar */
.app-bar{
  position:fixed;
  top:0;
  right:0;
  left:0;
  z-index:40;
  background:var(--control);
  color:#FFFFFF;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top);
  border-bottom:3px solid var(--primary);
  box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(20,22,34,0.22);
}
.app-bar-inner{
  height:60px;
  padding:0 12px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
}
.app-bar-right{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  min-width:0;
}
.icon-btn{
  width:44px;
  height:44px;
  border-radius:12px;
  border:none;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  color:#FFFFFF;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.icon-btn:active{
  transform:scale(0.93);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
}

  margin-right
